summary: Mandatory registration or state license for food manufacturers, restaurants, bakeries, cloud kitchens, and street food operators.

steps.title: Determine eligibility category
steps.description: Check annual turnover: under ₹12 Lakh requires basic Registration; between ₹12 Lakh and ₹20 Crore requires a State License.

steps.title: Create account on FoSCoS portal
steps.description: Register on the Food Safety Compliance System (FoSCoS) using valid mobile number and email ID.

steps.title: Complete Form A or Form B
steps.description: Fill in premises address, nature of food business, proposed list of food categories to be handled, and equipment details.

steps.title: Upload food safety declarations
steps.description: Submit standard food safety management system (FSMS) plan, water test report, and food handler medical fitness certificate.

steps.title: Pay license fee online
steps.description: Pay government prescribed fee through online payment gateway (UPI/Net banking/Card).

steps.title: Food safety officer inspection
steps.description: For state licenses, a Food Safety Officer conducts premise verification for hygiene standards.

steps.title: Download FSSAI license certificate
steps.description: Upon verification approval, download the 14-digit FSSAI registration certificate with QR code.
